mapper.sql: cluster_id,COUNT(*) record_count,COUNT(DISTINCT logical_channel) logical_channel_count, MIN(reported_at) first_occurred_at,MAX(reported_at) last_occurred_at, COALESCE(SUM(attachment_count),0) attachment_count,COALESCE(SUM(screenshot_count),0) screenshot_count, COALESCE(SUM(log_count),0) log_count,COALESCE(SUM(video_count),0) video_count, COALESCE(SUM(logical_channel='LEARNING_MACHINE'),0) station_count, COALESCE(SUM(logical_channel='JIRA'),0) jira_count, COALESCE(SUM(logical_channel='QUALITY'),0) quality_count, COALESCE(SUM(logical_channel='REDBLACK'),0) redblack_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_phase_one_feedback_cluster_member_projection WHERE AND source_id=#{sourceId} AND cluster_status NOT IN ('MERGED','SPLIT_ARCHIVED') LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) all_total,COALESCE(SUM(logical_channel_count>1),0) cross_channel_total FROM ( SELECT cluster_id,COUNT(DISTINCT logical_channel) logical_channel_count FROM t_phase_one_feedback_cluster_member_projection WHERE AND cluster_status NOT IN ('MERGED','SPLIT_ARCHIVED') GROUP BY cluster_id ) governed_clusters

SELECT FROM t_phase_one_feedback_cluster_member_projection WHERE AND cluster_status NOT IN ('MERGED','SPLIT_ARCHIVED') GROUP BY cluster_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT logical_channel)>1 ORDER BY record_count DESC,last_occurred_at DESC,cluster_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM t_phase_one_feedback_cluster_member_projection WHERE AND cluster_id=#{clusterId} GROUP BY cluster_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_phase_one_feedback_cluster_member_projection WHERE AND cluster_id=#{clusterId}

SELECT cluster_id,application_name dimension_value,COUNT(*) count FROM t_phase_one_feedback_cluster_member_projection WHERE AND cluster_id IN #{value} AND NULLIF(application_name,'') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cluster_id,application_name ORDER BY cluster_id,count DESC,application_name

SELECT cluster_id,region_value dimension_value,COUNT(*) count FROM t_phase_one_feedback_cluster_member_projection WHERE AND cluster_id IN #{value} AND NULLIF(region_value,'') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cluster_id,region_value ORDER BY cluster_id,count DESC,region_value

SELECT cluster_id,source_id FROM ( SELECT cluster_id,source_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY cluster_id ORDER BY reported_at DESC,source_id DESC) AS rn FROM t_phase_one_feedback_cluster_member_projection WHERE AND cluster_id IN #{value} ) ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY cluster_id
